fields.v: Preprocessing: collect 1.68M GitHub skills -> validate -> deduplicate -> agentic profiling (Claude Code) -> task synthesis for verifiable skills. Per task: (1) pre-task recommendation (agent searches skill library with Grep/Glob/Read, selects skills, writes usage guide); (2) solver agent executes; (3) post-task attribution (resume solver session, split trajectory into subtasks, assign outcome evidence and responsibility, extract reusable delta); (4) controlled evolution (admit only successful reusable exploration, aggregate, route to edit/create/skip)

fields.v: Benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 2.0 (89 tasks, default order as stream) and SWE-Bench Pro public (731 tasks, one stream per repository). Configurations: 3 model-effort pairs x {w/o skills, online SkillsVote/ReasoningBank/skill-creator, offline TB-Pro/Curated}. Baseline: w/o skills. Held constant: harness (Harbor + Codex CLI 0.125.0), solver configuration, timeout (4x default), retry policy (up to 3 for environment failures), verifier settings; built-in skills/plugins disabled. Acceptance tests: benchmark verifiers. Repetitions: TB 5 independent runs/jobs (avg@5); SWE 1 run. Human intervention: none

fields.v: SkillsVote online beats no-skills baseline in all six benchmark-model pairs (TB +2.6/+1.1/+0.9; SWE +2.7/+2.6/+1.2 pp) and is best or tied-best online method (tied with skill-creator for GPT-5.2 on TB). Offline TB-Pro gives largest TB gains (+7.8/+5.8/+1.4). Curated mixed (TB +3.7/+4.0/-1.7; SWE helps only GPT-5.4 mini). Baselines regress on GPT-5.5. Hard-split results mixed (e.g. SkillsVote online -6.7 on TB Hard for GPT-5.2). On TB 2.0 Hard, recommendation changes mean task-level gain/loss from +3.3/-6.7 to +6.0/-6.0 (online library) and from +11.3/-3.3 to +15.3/-2.0 (offline library). Routing: GPT-5.5 recommender above SkillRouter in FC@10 at all pool sizes. No significance tests
